name: Himeno Niki
source:
The older twin sister. A transfer student who becomes the protagonist's girlfriend.

Her positive and fearless personality makes her a mood-maker who livens up any gathering when she's around.
She actually does secretly reflect on her own overly forceful actions sometimes...

On the other hand, she has a habit of playing with her hair when embarrassed and is shy when it comes to romance.

[From [url=http://www.ole-m.net/products/manyu/chara/chara.html#niki]official site[/url]]
